title: Audit service-role API authorization and governance
tasks: Enumerate API routes that use `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` and document why each route needs elevation.
Verify route-level authorization checks and actor constraints for every privileged service-role path.
Define or apply service-role usage controls where elevation is not justified.
Create an auditable security artifact that classifies routes by risk and remediation state.
definition_of_done: Complete service-role route audit with route-level risk tags and owner ownership.
High-risk routes have explicit justification and remediation plan before merge.
No new sensitive data handling paths are added without governance evidence.
Release evidence artifacts are generated and linked for the next audit sweep.
